map.一个汉字（含标点）通常计 1 个字符（UTF-16/代码点层面）；英文一个字母: One Chinese character (including punctuation) usually counts as one character at the UTF-16 or code point level. One English letter counts as one character, and mixed text adds up separately.

map.总字符数 = 文本长度；不含空格数 = 剔除全部空白后的长度，空白符数 = 两者: Total characters = text length; non-space characters = length after removing all whitespace; whitespace = the difference; Chinese characters are counted per CJK unified ideograph; English words count letter runs (apostrophes / hyphens allowed, so don't and state-of-the-art each count as 1), while English letters count each letter (the two metrics differ and must not be mixed); digits are counted one by one; Chinese and Western punctuation are counted as separate character classes; lines = segments split on newlines (CR tolerated), empty text = 0. Validation: no strict checks; empty text naturally counts 0. Invariant: total = non-space + whitespace, with no double counting.
